coverage.main: Read all seventeen pages of arXiv 2012.11207v4 (26 October 2021, NeurIPS 2021 stamp): Sections 1-5, Tables 1-7, Figures 1-6, references and Appendices A-F (C&W comparison Figure 7, loss trends Figure 8, step-size Figure 9, example Figures 10-12). The NeurIPS proceedings PDF was not retrieved separately.
coverage.supplement: Appendices A-F are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: Table 7 (targeted UAPs) is reported per model without a stated source-target split; it is treated as same-model UAP success, not transfer. Figure 2 reports white-box and black-box target-class confidence and rank curves, not rates. Figures 4-6 and 10-12 are qualitative.

result_groups.population: 1,000 ImageNet-compatible development images with the dataset's official target labels; single-source to single-target pairs among ResNet50, DenseNet121, VGG16, Inception-v3; 20/100/300 iterations
result_groups.outcome: targeted transfer success rate (Figure 1 also shows non-targeted curves)
result_groups.evidence: No clean-correct or source-success rule is stated.

result_groups.population: 1,000 images; easy hold-out ensemble (Inception/ResNet families) and a challenging ensemble with no architectural overlap
1,000 images with target classes chosen by rank position (2nd to 1000th) in the original prediction list
result_groups.evidence: Source, target model and population rule are not restated for Table 3.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.1 'Transfer-based attacks on Google Cloud Vision'; Table 4 (p. 8)
result_groups.population: 100 images that originally yield correct predictions on the Google Cloud Vision API; adversarial images crafted on the four-model ensemble (300 iterations)
result_groups.outcome: non-targeted success: ground-truth class absent from the returned label list; targeted success: target class present (semantically similar labels merged)
result_groups.evidence: The API evaluation is explicitly restricted to images the API originally predicts correctly. No source-success rule is stated.

result_groups.population: The dataset under TTP's '10-Targets (all-source)' setting; ResNet50 or ResNet ensemble source; DenseNet121 and VGG16_bn targets; epsilon 16 and 8
result_groups.evidence: Population follows a prior protocol that is not restated.

result_groups.population: 4,000 examples initialised as Gaussian noise, each optimised to a random target class on ResNet50; DenseNet121 and VGG16 targets
result_groups.outcome: targeted transfer success rate of unbounded images
result_groups.evidence: Inputs are noise, so a clean-correct event is undefined; no source-success rule stated.

f1.evidence: No clean accuracy is reported for any model or the API; the API subset is selected by correctness.

f2.evidence: The Google Cloud Vision scope is explicitly clean-correct (yes); all other scopes are unresolved.

f3.evidence: No source-success rule or explicit inclusion statement in any scope.

f4.evidence: Table 4's integer percentages over the stated 100 images identify counts. For the other tables, the 1,000-image denominator is not stated as the rate denominator, and Table 5 follows an external protocol.

f5.evidence: L-infinity epsilon = 16 is explicit for the main results and epsilon = 8 for part of Table 5. Table 6 is explicitly unbounded by design. Neither is missing reporting, but the field's affirmative coverage of all results is not met.

f6.evidence: The official repository releases the 1,000 images, labels and per-scenario evaluation scripts on public torchvision models, and API prediction logs from a later human evaluation. The Table 4 API outcomes cannot be regenerated against the 2021 service. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Linked in the paper (URL spelled Targeted-Tansfer; the GitHub API resolves Targeted-Transfer). 1,027 files, head 17 November 2022: dataset images and images.csv, eval_single/ensemble/low_ranked/10_targets/unbounded/tUAP.py, and human_eval/ with Google API prediction text files. eval_single.py counts, every 20 iterations, the adversarial images whose target-model prediction equals the target label over all images. No clean-correct or source-success filter; artifact evidence only. Not executed.

bounds_checks.reason: Targeted success is not an untargeted misclassification probability, and no clean baselines are reported.
Rates are over API-clean-correct images with a label-list outcome; no unconditional baseline.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. Table 7 is excluded on the reading that each UAP is evaluated on the model it was generated for; an independent recoder could read it differently.
